pavel: adding a tiny table and a jq + sed one-liner for infra teams. keeping it copy-paste friendly.
pavel: jq transform (ms -> s) for JSON:
```bash
jq '.cooldown_seconds = (.scaleCooldownMs / 1000 | floor) | del(.scaleCooldownMs)' policy.json > policy.migrated.json
```
pavel: sed example for YAML-ish files (quick):
```bash
sed -E 's/scaleCooldownMs:/cooldown_seconds: /; s/([0-9]+)\s*#?ms/\1s/' policy.yaml > policy.migrated.yaml
```
tasha: can you add the tiny SDK snippets inline? one terraform block and one 1-line python call.
courtney: adding both now. terraform snippet:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_scale_policy" "compat" {
  tenant_id        = "tenant-compat"
  min_gpus         = 1
  max_gpus         = 3
  cooldown_seconds = 120
  preemption_policy = "best-effort"
}
```
python one-liner:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient; DedicatedClient().set_scale_policy("tenant-compat", min_gpus=1, max_gpus=3, cooldown_seconds=120, preemption_policy="best-effort")
```
